QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] You Jelly
QuestInfo.0: Christopher doesn't seem content with just one Royal Jelly. Talk to him in #bSwarm Habitat 3#k.
QuestInfo.1: Christopher wants MORE jellies. Collect 10 Royal Jellies from the General Hornets in Swarm Habitat 3 and then take them back to Christopher.
QuestInfo.2: You got 10 Royal Jelly items for Christopher.

0.0: Words CANNOT describe what I've just experienced. I feel... like I am younger by 10 years now. It tasted like utopia or paradise or nirvana. Cloud nine.
0.1: PLEASE. I need more. I need #r10 Royal Jellies#k or I might as well just jump off a cliff.

yes.0: Thanks. I want others to be jelly of my jelly!\r\n#b(Hunt down the General Hornet in the Swarm Habitat 3 to get Royal Jelly.)#k

1.0: Are those... really Royal Jellies for my belly?

yes.0: Tears. Of joy. Streaming down my face. So hard. Mmmm. This is a flavor sensation!

item.0: Can you be a pal and get me 10 Royal Jelly items? I need them. So bad.\r\n#b(Hunt down the General Hornets to get Royal Jelly.)#k
